summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, announcing a quarterly dividend of US$0.03 per common share for Q2 2026, payable on July 15 to holders of record on June 30. The filing also details a Dividend Election Alternative allowing registered shareholders to elect to receive dividends in Tether Gold XAU tokens instead of cash, facilitated by Equiniti and Bullish. This is a routine capital return and novel dividend payment mechanism, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, or restructuring event. Watch for shareholder adoption of the token option and regulatory implications.
